name: Podio
one_liner: Podio (Progress) work platform with apps, items, tasks and a public REST API.
auth_notes: OAuth2 with server-side, client-side, username/password and app authentication flows; API key (client_id/secret) created in account settings.
access_notes: Free plan (up to 5 users) lists 1000 API calls per hour; higher limits need paid API add-ons (paid plans only). Some operations need Podio support approval per first pass.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API key on free plan, documented REST API with webhooks and 1000 calls/hour; higher limits need paid add-on. Official MCP is beta.

evidence.quote: API Integrations | 1000 calls per hour | 1000 calls per hour Upgrade with Add-ons
The general limit is 1,000 API calls per hour
Hooks are webhooks that can call external sites when certain actions occur in Podio.
The Podio MCP Server is currently in beta and is intended for evaluation and testing.

disputes.why: Pricing page shows Free plan with 1000 API calls per hour; paid only for add-ons.
Doc index lists dozens of areas (items, apps, tasks, hooks, files, etc.); count not verified.
